summary: Iteration-4 (Cariler) backend + frontend testing. Backend: added TestCariler (full CRUD + cascading delete + totals) and TestCariIncomeExpense (cari_name resolution on incomes/expenses, /api/summary cari sums & math, /api/dashboard/monthly-trend inclusion of cari tx). 5 new tests added; pytest total 38 passed, 1 skipped by design. Frontend: Playwright flow verified sidebar nav order (Giderler → Cariler → Faturalar), /cariler list + search + create dialog, row click → /cariler/:id detail, add Alacak 5000 + Borç 1500 → KPI cards show ₺5.000,00 / ₺1.500,00 / Net ₺3.500,00, Tümü/Alacaklar/Borçlar tabs filter correctly (1/1/2), Gelirler form exposes 'income-form-cari' Select, cleanup via delete flow succeeded (toast 'Cari silindi'). No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1551 lines — strongly advise splitting into routers (auth, finance, cariler, inventory, email, reports, dashboard). Growing cariler block adds another ~170 lines.

_attach_cari_totals runs an extra MongoDB query per cari on every list_cariler call (N+1). For a handful of cariler it is fine but will degrade with growth; consider a single $lookup + $group aggregation or caching totals on the cari doc updated via tx hooks.

GET /api/cariler/{cari_id}/transactions returns 404 if cari was deleted — good. But DELETE /api/cariler/{cari_id}/transactions/{tx_id} does NOT verify cari exists (only checks tx id+cari_id combo). Harmless since tx is cascaded-deleted, but worth documenting.
monthly-trend aggregates cari tx without filtering out tx for deleted cariler — but delete_cari already cascades tx, so no orphans in practice.

cari_id passed to incomes/expenses is NOT validated — if an invalid id is sent, _resolve_cari_name silently returns None and cari_name is stored null (cari_id is still stored as-is). Consider rejecting with 400 or clearing cari_id when name unresolved.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core cariler flow + nav + Gelirler cari selector
